rentable_area_sqft.value: Approximately 2,750 sq ft at the Commencement Date (Premises-A), expanding to approximately 5,500 sq ft from the first day of month 7
rentable_area_sqft.quote: On the Commencement Date, the Premises shall be deemed to consist of approximately 2,750 square feet
rentable_area_sqft.note: Premises leased in two phases of approx. 2,750 sq ft each; total 5,500 sq ft from Premises-B Expansion Date (month 7), or earlier if the Electricity Consumption Threshold is exceeded 3 times in 5 days. Figures are 'approximately' and are not stated as rentable area.

commencement_date.value: Conditional: the date on which Landlord completes Site Commissioning/Turn-Up (Level 5 Commissioning) and delivers possession of the Tenant Space with Landlord's Installations complete. Target Commencement Date is November 1, 2007 (commercially reasonable efforts only); Landlord confirms by Commencement Date Notice.
commencement_date.quote: The “Commencement Date” shall be the date on which all of the following events (“Commencement Date Conditions”) have occurred:
commencement_date.note: No fixed date. If conditions are not met by the Target Commencement Date it is postponed; Tenant may terminate if not met before December 31, 2007 (subject to Tenant Delay/Force Majeure extensions).

expiration_date.value: 48 full calendar months after the Commencement Date (no fixed date, because the Commencement Date is conditional)
expiration_date.quote: Approximately 48 months (commencing on the Commencement date and expiring forty-eight (48) full calendar months thereafter (Lease End))
expiration_date.note: Expiry depends on the conditional Commencement Date; subject to extension or earlier termination.

initial_monthly_base_rent.quote: $41,250.00 per month for the period commencing with the Commencement Date through the end of the sixth (6th) month of the Term.
initial_monthly_base_rent.note: Monthly figure is stated directly. The first month's Base Rent ($41,250) is prepaid on lease execution. Electricity is billed separately.

rent_escalation.value: Stepped schedule: $41,250/mo (months 1-6); $82,500/mo (months 7-12, after expansion to Premises-B); $84,975/mo (months 13-24); $87,524/mo (months 25-36); $90,150/mo (months 37-48). Rent steps up early to the next level if Tenant exceeds the Electricity Consumption Threshold 3 times in any 5-day period. During the Extension Term, Base Rent rises each year to 103% of the prior year's Base Rent.
rent_escalation.normalised: Stepped: 41,250 -> 82,500 -> 84,975 -> 87,524 -> 90,150 per month; 3% annual increases in the Extension Term
rent_escalation.quote: $82,500.00 per month for months 7-12 of the Term.
rent_escalation.note: Schedule is from Item 9; the early-increase trigger is in Item 7(a)(bb); the 103% extension rent is in Section 2.3.1.

renewal_option.value: One (1) Extension Option for a 48-month Extension Term, covering the entire Tenant Space, on the same terms, with Base Rent at 103% of the prior year's Base Rent for each year of the extension.
renewal_option.quote: One (1) Extension Option (defined in Section 2.3.1 of the Standard Lease Provisions, below)
renewal_option.note: Section 2.3.1 confirms an additional term of 48 calendar months. Landlord may treat the exercise as invalid if there is an uncured Event of Default.
renewal_option.flag: value not visible in quote (derived or calculated)

renewal_notice_months.value: At least 9 months (and not more than 12 months) before the expiration date of the Term
renewal_notice_months.quote: at least nine (9) calendar months (and not more than twelve (12) calendar months) prior to then applicable expiration date of the Term
renewal_notice_months.note: 9 months is the minimum notice. The exercise window is 12 to 9 months before expiry, and time is of the essence.

early_termination.value: No termination-for-convenience or fee-based early termination right. Tenant has only contingent termination rights. (1) It may terminate if the Commencement Date Conditions have not occurred before December 31, 2007 (subject to Tenant Delay/Force Majeure). (2) It may terminate for a Chronic Outage (3 or more Interruptions of Landlord's Services of 12+ consecutive hours within 12 months) or a Continuous Outage (30 consecutive days) by notice within 5 business days of the occurrence. Tenancy then continues for 180 days, or less on 90 days' notice. (3) It may terminate after a Casualty if the Stated Restoration Period exceeds 90 days or Landlord fails to restore on time. No termination fee is stated.
early_termination.normalised: No voluntary termination right; contingent rights only (late delivery, chronic/continuous outage, casualty)
early_termination.quote: Tenant may terminate this Lease by delivering to Landlord within five (5) business days following the occurrence of the Chronic Outage, written notice
early_termination.note: Summarised from Sections 2.2.2, 7.3.3, 7.3.4 and 9.1.1. Landlord also has a recapture/termination right on a proposed Transfer (Section 10.3). That is a Landlord right, not Tenant's.

security_deposit.value: $81,131.00, as either a cash security deposit or a letter of credit, to be provided within 30 days after the Effective Date
security_deposit.quote: pay Landlord a security deposit in the amount of $81,131.00
security_deposit.note: Tenant may choose a cash deposit or an L/C for the same amount and may switch once during the term. This is separate from the $41,250 prepaid first month's rent.
